sql:
SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 50 AND 70
GROUP BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  fish_date_season,
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as num_boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 50 AND 70
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5')
GROUP BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
LIMIT 30
